test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the National Multidimensional Poverty Index of NITI Aayog 2021, which of the following states has less than 1% multidimensionally Poor of its total population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the National Multidimensional Poverty Index of NITI Aayog 2021, Kerala has less than 1% of its total population classified as multidimensionally poor.
 
• The National Multidimensional Poverty Index measures poverty based on various indicators including health, education, and standard of living.
 
• Kerala's high performance in health and education sectors contributes significantly to its low multidimensional poverty rate.
 
• This achievement highlights Kerala's effective social policies and inclusive development strategies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is a comprehensive measure that reflects the multiple deprivations that poor people face in their daily lives.
 
• NITI Aayog's MPI is aligned with the global MPI methodology developed by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• States like Kerala, which have invested heavily in social sectors, show lower levels of multidimensional poverty.
 
• The MPI is part of India's efforts to monitor and track progress towards Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly Goal 1: No Poverty.
